eventDecisions.name: 中国船舶
eventDecisions.reason: Global capacity scarcity plus company Q1 profit inflection and RMB225bn orderbook create a direct multi-year earnings bridge. The expression remains Research because orderbook monetization is long-duration, merger/restructuring context adds complexity, and expectation burden is not proven roomy.
The event is a cross-sectional risk filter rather than a clean positive thesis. Company incidence is heterogeneous and no cutoff-valid superior beneficiary was identified under unchanged V1.9.

The industry monetization channel is real, but at the June checkpoint no equally fresh direct A-share license-out cash/earnings bridge was frozen for the selected-company layer. Later Hengrui deals cannot be backfilled.
The policy may alter supply timing, but weak hog prices/oversupply make the earnings direction ambiguous. Cost leadership alone is not a fresh positive driver.

eventDecisions.name: 宝丰能源
eventDecisions.reason: The broad hub surfaced a relative cost-curve change; Baofeng had already reported +73% H1 profit and +93% operating cash flow with large new polyolefin volume. Price regime was neutral. Commodity spread durability and new-capacity supply risk block Primary.
